info.name: Falcon E-Commerce Mobile App API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Falcon E-Commerce mobile application developers (iOS / Android / Flutter / React Native). Covers Authentication with OTP, Customer Profile & Addresses, Products with Multiple Variant Images, Categories, Cart, Checkout, Orders, Tracking, Payments, Wishlist, Coupons, Notifications, Reviews, and File Uploads.

All endpoints include Required and Optional fields clearly documented.

variable.description: Backend server base URL (e.g., http://localhost:5001 or production domain)
JWT Bearer access token received from /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/register
JWT Bearer token for admin operations

item.name: 1. Authentication & OTP
item.description: Customer onboarding, OTP verification via email, login, token refresh, and profile check endpoints.

request.description:
### Register a New Customer Account

**Body Parameters:**
- `username` *(Required)*: Unique username
- `email` *(Required)*: Valid email address
- `password` *(Required)*: Password (min 6 characters)
- `mobile` *(Required)*: Saudi mobile format (e.g. `+966501234567` or `0501234567`)
- `first_name` *(Optional)*: Customer first name
- `last_name` *(Optional)*: Customer last name

**Response:**
Returns JWT `token`, `refreshToken`, and `user` object.

### Login with Email / Mobile / Username

**Body Parameters:**
- `identifier` *(Required if email/mobile not sent)*: Email, Mobile or Username
- `email` *(Optional)*: Direct email input
- `mobile` *(Optional)*: Direct mobile input
- `password` *(Required)*: User password

**Response:**
Returns `token`, `refreshToken`, and user profile. Automatically copy `token` into `{{authToken}}`.

### Send 6-Digit Email Verification Code

**Body Parameters:**
- `email` *(Required)*: Email address to receive the verification OTP
- `type` *(Optional)*: Verification purpose (default: `EMAIL_VERIFICATION` or `PASSWORD_RESET`)

### Verify 6-Digit Code

**Body Parameters:**
- `email` *(Required)*: User email
- `code` *(Required)*: 6-digit code received via email

### Get Current User Profile
Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}` header.

### Refresh Access Token

**Body Parameters:**
- `refreshToken` *(Required)*: Refresh token obtained during login/register
Check if a username is already taken before submitting the registration form.
Check if a mobile number is already registered.
Logout the current user session and revoke refresh tokens.

item.name: 2. Customer Profile & Addresses
item.description: Customer profile management and delivery addresses.

request.description: Retrieve customer details, default address, and statistics.

### Update Customer Details

**Body Parameters:**
- `first_name` *(Optional)*: First name
- `last_name` *(Optional)*: Last name
- `mobile` *(Optional)*: Phone number
- `preferred_language` *(Optional)*: 'en' or 'ar'
List all saved delivery addresses for the customer.

### Add New Delivery Address

**Body Parameters:**
- `full_name` *(Required)*: Contact name for delivery
- `mobile` *(Required)*: Contact mobile
- `address_line` *(Required)*: Building, street, flat
- `city` *(Required)*: City (e.g. Riyadh, Jeddah)
- `area` *(Optional)*: District / Neighborhood (e.g. Al Olaya)
- `state` *(Optional)*: Province (e.g. Riyadh Province)
- `postal_code` *(Optional)*: Postal zip code
- `country` *(Optional)*: Country (default: 'Saudi Arabia')
- `is_default` *(Optional)*: boolean (true to set as default address)

body.raw:
{
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "mobile": "+966501234567",
  "address_line": "Building 42, King Fahd Road",
  "area": "Al-Olaya District",
  "city": "Riyadh",
  "state": "Riyadh Province",
  "postal_code": "13211",
  "country": "Saudi Arabia",
  "is_default": true
}

request.description:
### Update Existing Address

item.name: 3. Products & Multi-Variant Images

query.description: Keyword search in name, description, SKU, brand
Filter by category or subcategory ID
Sort column: createdAt | price | rating | is_best_seller

request.description:
### List Products
Returns products catalog with category, product images, and variants with multiple variant images.

item.name: Get Product Detail By ID (With Multi-Images per Variant)

request.description:
### Get Product Details
Returns full product information, including:
- `images`: Array of product main gallery images
- `has_variants`: boolean
- `variants`: Array of variants (e.g. 1L, 2L, 5L, 1kg), each variant includes:
  - `images`: Array of variant images (`[{ id, image_url, is_primary, sort_order }]`)
  - `image_url`: Legacy fallback synced to primary image
  - `price`, `discount_price`, `stock_quantity`, `sku`, `unit_value`, `unit_type`, `pack_size`

item.name: Admin: Create Product with Multi-Image Variants

request.description:
### Admin: Create Product

**Body Parameters:**
- `name_en` *(Required)*: English product title
- `name_ar` *(Required)*: Arabic product title
- `sku` *(Required)*: Unique product SKU
- `category_id` *(Required)*: Category UUID
- `price` *(Required)*: Default unit price (SAR)
- `discount_price` *(Optional)*: Discounted price
- `stock_quantity` *(Required)*: Inventory stock
- `has_variants` *(Optional)*: boolean (true if multi-variant)
- `variants` *(Optional, Required if has_variants is true)*: Array of variant objects:
  - `sku` *(Required)*: Variant SKU
  - `unit_value` *(Required)*: Numeric size (e.g. 1, 2, 5)
  - `unit_type` *(Required)*: L, kg, ml, g, pcs
  - `pack_size` *(Optional)*: e.g. 'pack of 1'
  - `price` *(Required)*: Variant price
  - `discount_price` *(Optional)*: Variant discount
  - `stock_quantity` *(Required)*: Variant stock
  - `images` *(Optional)*: Up to 5 images per variant (`[{ image_url, is_primary, sort_order }]`)
- `images` *(Optional)*: Array of main product images (`[{ image_url, is_primary, display_order }]`)

item.name: 5. Cart
item.description: Shopping cart management for authenticated customers (and guest cart calculation reference).

request.description:
### Retrieve Customer Cart
Returns subtotal, tax (15% VAT), and items list. Each item includes the resolved variant primary image, SKU, size, and available stock.

item.name: Add Item to Cart (Product or Variant)

request.description:
### Add Product / Variant to Cart

**Body Parameters:**
- `productId` *(Required)*: Product UUID
- `variantId` *(Optional / Required for multi-variant products)*: Variant UUID
- `quantity` *(Optional)*: Quantity to add (default: 1)

### Update Item Quantity

**Body Parameters:**
- `quantity` *(Required)*: New quantity (setting 0 deletes the item)
Delete an individual item from the customer's cart.
Remove all items from the customer's shopping cart.

item.name: 6. Orders & Checkout
item.description: Order placement, live delivery tracking, cancellation, and re-order operations.

request.description:
### Place Order from Current Cart

**Body Parameters:**
- `addressId` *(Required)*: UUID of selected delivery address
- `paymentMethod` *(Required)*: 'COD' | 'MADA' | 'VISA' | 'APPLE_PAY' | 'BANK_TRANSFER'
- `couponCode` *(Optional)*: Valid coupon code string
- `deliveryDate` *(Optional)*: Date string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format
- `deliverySlot` *(Optional)*: Slot label (e.g. '09:00 AM - 12:00 PM')
- `deliverySpeed` *(Optional)*: 'standard' (SAR 0) or 'express' (SAR 12)
- `notes` *(Optional)*: Special delivery instructions

body.raw:
{
  "addressId": "YOUR_SAVED_ADDRESS_UUID",
  "paymentMethod": "COD",
  "couponCode": "WELCOME10",
  "deliveryDate": "2026-10-27",
  "deliverySlot": "09:00 AM - 12:00 PM",
  "deliverySpeed": "standard",
  "notes": "Please leave at front door and ring bell."
}

request.description:
### Customer Order History
Returns list of customer orders with status, total, delivery slot, driver info, and item thumbnails (displaying variant primary images).
Full order details including line items with variant images, price breakdown, status history timeline, driver details, and ZATCA invoice.

### Real-Time Live Driver Tracking
Returns driver GPS coordinates, vehicle temperature sensor reading, and ETA when status is 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' or 'ARRIVED'.

### Cancel Order
Eligible while order status is PENDING, CONFIRMED, or PROCESSING.

**Body Parameters:**
- `reason` *(Required)*: Selected cancellation reason
- `remarks` *(Optional)*: Additional customer comments

### Reorder Items from Past Order

**Body Parameters:**
- `preview` *(Optional)*: true to only preview stock availability, false to add directly to cart
- `customSelections` *(Optional)*: Array of item selections with `productId`, `variantId`, `quantity`, `skip`

item.name: 7. Payments
item.description: Payment verification for Online Gateway (Mada / Apple Pay / Visa) and Bank Transfer proof slip upload.

item.name: Verify Gateway Payment (Card / Apple Pay / Mada)

request.description:
### Verify Online Payment Gateway

**Body Parameters:**
- `orderId` *(Required)*: Order UUID
- `transactionId` *(Required)*: Payment gateway transaction reference
- `gateway` *(Required)*: 'MADA' | 'VISA' | 'APPLE_PAY' | 'HYPERPAY' | 'TAP'
- `paymentId` *(Optional)*: Payment table record ID if known

### Submit Bank Transfer Receipt (Multipart/Form-Data)

**Form-Data Parameters:**
- `orderId` *(Required)*: Order UUID
- `transactionRef` *(Required)*: Bank transaction or transfer reference
- `paymentMethod` *(Required)*: 'BANK_TRANSFER'
- `proofFile` *(Required)*: Image or PDF receipt file
Retrieve all items in the customer's wishlist.

### Toggle Item in Wishlist

**Body Parameters:**
- `productId` *(Required)*: Product UUID
Remove a product from the wishlist by productId.

item.name: 10. File & Image Uploads
item.description: File upload endpoints supporting single and batch uploads for variant images, product galleries, and payment proofs.

request.description:
### Upload Single File (Multipart/Form-Data)

**Form-Data Parameters:**
- `file` *(Required)*: JPG, PNG, or WebP image (max 5MB)

**Response:**
Returns `relativePath` (e.g. `/uploads/file-123.jpg`) and `fullUrl`.

item.name: Upload Multiple Files (For Variant Images Gallery)

request.description:
### Upload Multiple Files (Multipart/Form-Data)

**Form-Data Parameters:**
- `files` *(Required)*: Up to 10 files (JPG, PNG, WebP, max 5MB each)

**Response:**
Returns array of uploaded files with URLs.
